Who we are

Packaging that does the job right

Boxcraft is a Johannesburg-based custom packaging manufacturer. We work with e-commerce brands, retailers, food producers, and anyone who needs a box that's built exactly to their product.

We started in 2018 with a single die-cutter and a focus on getting small orders right. Today we run a full production floor and ship across South Africa, but the focus hasn't changed.

Workshop photo
What we stand for

Precision

Every box is cut, scored, and printed to exact specification. We don't ship until it's right.

Turnaround

Five working days on standard orders. We know your deadlines matter.

Transparency

You see a digital proof before anything goes to press. No hidden costs, no surprises.

Scale

From 50-unit prototypes to 10,000-unit production runs — same quality either way.
